messages:
ana-partnerships: Kickoff for sierra-eu-west4 partner activation — hardware + marketplace + SI integration. Timeline = 3 weeks. Can partners (Hypernode + Catalyst) confirm capacity & entitlement paths? :rocket:

matt-ops: Heard back from Hypernode yesterday. They can provision 24x A100-equivalent blades for Dedicated pools. Need marketplace SKU entitlements and region quotas before we handover.

lee-platform: For Private customers we'll need the AMI/container images pushed to eu-west4 region (registry tag: redwood/sierra-eu-west4:v1). Also will need network subnets + egress rules from infra team.

kumar-systems: KMS note — Hypernode requires CMK wrap for cross-account keys. We need an HSM enablement request to security; can we get SO number? I'll file once partners confirm key policy.

ana-partnerships: @ana-partnerships (typo) — Catalyst (SI) wants a playbook for customer onboarding (1pager + runbook). Emily from SDKs wants to hook in for quickstart templates.

emily-sdks: I can draft a quickstart that shows: create cluster, set model pin, route to Dedicated SKU. Will need example config + token scopes. ETA 5 days.

ana-partnerships: Sarah, legal — we have a partner co-sell blurb and joint announcement draft. Any IP or embargo constraints?

sarah-legal: We need to avoid using Hypernode benchmark numbers in public press without their approval. Also request a 48h embargo window on announcements tied to Marketplace listing activation. I'll send redlines.

matt-ops: Quota asks: marketplace entitlement 50 vGPU units reserved, burst to 80 for first 30 days. Internal ticket created: CLD-8459. Can partnerships own the marketplace form?

ana-partnerships: I'll own the marketplace submission. Need exact SKU strings + billing meter ids from Hypernode. Hypernode contact: lara@hypernode.io. Catalyst contact: dev@catalystsi.com.

Hypernode (via ana-partnerships): Hypernode confirms sku ids: HN-A100-1U, HN-A100-4U; meter ids will be attached in the vendor portal by EOD tomorrow.

lee-platform: Ops checklist for runbook: (1) AMI/container publish (2) VPC peering + routes (3) KMS CMK policy link (4) Marketplace entitlement mapping -> routing policy. I'll post a checklist PR to infra-playbooks.

kumar-systems: Filing HSM/KMS request now. Ticket SEC-1290. Estimated approval 2 business days if no concerns.

ana-partnerships: Action items summary: 1) Marketplace submission (ana) — need SKU + meter ids (due +1 day). 2) AMI/container publish (lee) — due +3 days. 3) KMS/HSM request (kumar) — filed now. 4) Quickstart + runbook (emily + lee) — 5 days. 5) Legal redlines + embargo (sarah) — 48h notice. 6) Ops quota ticket (matt) — CLD-8459.

ana-partnerships: Can folks react with :white_check_mark: when you accept your items? Also planning a 30m sync Thurs 10:00 UTC to align on go/no-go.

deploy-bot: Scheduled reminder: Partnership sync — sierra-eu-west4 kickoff — Thu 10:00 UTC. Join: <https://call.redwood.ai/meeting/sierrakickoff>.

matt-ops: Accepting my item. I'll follow up on CLD-8459 with infra and escalation path for burst.

emily-sdks: Accepting. Will create PR for quickstart template and ping here when ready.

lee-platform: Accepting. Will open PR on infra-playbooks and tag this thread.

kumar-systems: Accepting. SEC-1290 linked in comments.

sarah-legal: Accepting; will send redlines within 24h.

ana-partnerships: Great — if we hit the deadlines we can target marketplace activation + partner announcement w/in 3 weeks. Thanks everyone! :tada:
